note: The reconnect on a running pipeline (chapter 15.4 B-39; srt-input listens with keep-listening, so a caller that queues reconnects into the same restamp): 60 s live, the link away 30 s while the caller queues, the queue drains in 1 s. The backlog's first PCR is a leap (-30 s against arrival): one relock, one gap of the outage per PID (reason epoch), the new epoch seeded on the backlog's oldest sample. A relock keeps the acquire slew (B-37), but two agreeing buckets more than backlog_ns (500 ms) below the line move it in any epoch; until then the stale rule drops what would leave more than 4 s ahead. One overlap run per PID, reason backlog, at 93.5-93.8 s, about 30 s each. Before the fix: degraded (lead) 5 s after the reconnect, then 29 s of live content dropped at the recovery.
